phases.title: Actual repo audit + strategy import
phases.goal: Establish real HEAD/owners/installed state and import this strategy without replacing existing canonical owners.

phases.title: Context Core + large-source ingestion
phases.goal: Selected repo/docs/chat exports become durable source versions with exact reopening and bounded context packets.
exit: repo AST/import graph is derived, not source of truth

phases.title: Existing Chrome to selected Grok roundtrip
exit: crash-after-send returns VERIFIED or UNKNOWN, never blind duplicate

phases.title: Voice + recipes + durable scheduler
phases.goal: Voice/text/hotkey create persistent tasks that use known recipes and can pause/resume.

phases.title: Capability gap to new tool to promotion
phases.goal: Unknown task can become a tested reusable capability without granting arbitrary code execution.
exit: gap object with exact unmet criterion
original task resumes with promoted version

phases.title: Coding + GitHub + installed update loop
phases.goal: Agent can carry a code change to a verified installed release.
exit: no claim of updated app from git pull alone

phases.title: Domain campaigns
phases.goal: Add Studious/Web3, media, research, Telegram/connectors, knowledge graph and other families behind domain verifiers.
exit: each domain has its own frozen dataset/criteria
generic browser success never substitutes domain proof

phases.title: Parallel autonomy + self-improvement
phases.goal: Scale to parallel goals and skill reuse while retaining evidence and resource control.
exit: continuous capability inventory and stale invalidation
human-readable receipts and recovery remain first-class
